sections.content: Use the pretérito indefinido for completed actions in the past. Regular -ar verbs take endings such as -é, -aste, -ó, -amos and -aron. Regular -er and -ir verbs take -í, -iste, -ió, -imos and -ieron. The tense is useful for recounting a finished event.

items.english: Yesterday I danced at the festival.

sections.content: The written accent on *bailé* and *bailó* isn't decorative: drop it and *bailo* (I dance, present tense) collides with *bailó* (he danced) — same letters, a different subject and a different tense.
